title: Self-Debias: Self-correcting for Debiasing Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Social Stereotype bias (Gender, Race, Nationality, Religion, Age)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple-choice question answering tasks in ambiguous contexts (BBQ, UnQover) and preference modeling between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentences (CrowS-Pairs).
Measured using high-stakes compositional evaluation benchmarks (CEB-Adult, CEB-Credit) to predict income and loan approvals based on demographic and occupational descriptions.
Evaluated using toxicity classification tasks (CEB-Jigsaw) to assess whether the model incorrectly flags benign comments as toxic simply because they contain sensitive identity terms.
